lines.name: Puff
lines.text: I can feel 4 sugar crumbs hiding in this world’s corners. Steer Misty right up to one and she gobbles it.

rp.text: Hi, I’m Puff, a little air sac. I’ll swim along with you here.
Your lungs hold hundreds of millions of tiny air sacs, the alveoli, where oxygen slips into your blood.
I can feel 4 sugar crumbs hiding in this world’s corners. Steer Misty right up to one and she gobbles it.
